//: Copy to config.json and fill in your values. Never commit config.json.

tavily.//: Tavily search API (V3.4). API key free at tavily.com. Uses TAVILY_API_KEY env var.

domainTrust.//: Opt-in domain reputation filtering. Off by default.

llm.//: OpenAI-compatible LLM for contextual embeddings (optional). Base URL required; API token optional. provider = model name (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, llama3).

raga.//: RAG-Anything Bridge for multimodal document extraction (PDFs, Office, etc.).

duckduckgo.//: Zero-key fallback search (V3.3.1). Region / safeSearch configurable via env vars.

ollamaSearch.//: Opt-in Ollama web-search backend (V3.3.1). Uses SEARCH_OLLAMA_* env vars — distinct from EMBEDDING_OLLAMA_*.

deepResearch.//: Deep Research Orchestration Engine (V4.0.0). Opt-in, disabled by default.
deepResearch.//baseUrl: OpenAI-compatible base URL for LLM calls. Do NOT include /v1 — it is appended automatically (e.g. http://localhost:11434)
deepResearch.//apiToken: Optional API token for authenticated LLM endpoints (e.g. OpenAI API key)
deepResearch.//model: Orchestrator model — mid-tier for planning, evaluation, audit, synthesis (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4)
deepResearch.//workerModel: Worker model — cheap for extraction, classification (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, llama-3.1-8b)

rescoreWeights.//: Per-tool rescoring weights. Tune these to prioritize recency, citations, etc.
